content.title: How US–China tensions fuel rare earth 'supply-squeeze' fears
content.description:
Rare earth stocks, like MP Materials (MP), USA Rare Earth (USAR), and Critical Metals (CRML), are in focus as China's rare earth dominance has become a major factor in US–China trade talks.

Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and eToro global market analyst Lale Akoner join Opening Bid to discuss the recent price moves.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.

content.title: Why Nothing Can Stop MP Materials Stock, at Least for Now
content.summary: MP Materials  stock and shares of other rare-earth miners jumped again on Monday, extending last week’s rally after China tightened export controls on the minerals.  MP Materials stock rose 21.3% to $95.06, a record close.  Smaller rare-earth companies  USA Rare Earth  and  Ramaco Resources  rose 18.6% and 11.1%, respectively, after closing higher on Friday.
